general.name: App name
general.addressHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Changing it breaks old links.
general.slugInvalid: Use 3–42 lowercase letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter
general.timezoneHint: Used for dates and scheduled jobs.
general.themeDesc: Accent colour, light or dark mode and corner style of the generated app.
general.archiveDesc: Production stops accepting sign-ins. Records are kept for 90 days and an admin can restore the app.
general.deleteDesc: Deletes every environment, record and file. This can’t be undone.
general.deleteConfirmBody: Every environment, release, record and file of this app will be deleted for everyone. This can’t be undone.
general.ownersOnly: Only Owners and Admins can archive or delete the app.

members.removeDesc: They lose access right away. Their past changes stay in the history.
members.lastOwner: A project needs at least one Owner

roleDesc.owner: Everything, including releases to Production, members and deleting the app.
roleDesc.admin: Everything except deleting the app. Can release to Production and edit secrets.
roleDesc.editor: Change pages, data, logic and storage. Release to Staging.
roleDesc.viewer: Open the Studio and preview. Can’t change anything.

auth.methodsDesc: How app users prove who they are. Studio members always sign in with Platon.
auth.passwordDesc: Users set a password. Reset links go by email.
auth.magicDesc: One-time sign-in link sent by email. No password.
auth.providersDesc: Providers shown on the app’s sign-in page · {n} of {total} enabled
auth.finishSetup: Fill in the connection details to finish setting up {name}
auth.defaultRoleHint: Given on first sign-in through this provider.
auth.redirectHint: Add this in the provider’s console.

eimzo.name: E-IMZO
eimzo.desc: Electronic digital signature · USB key or ID card

ldap.name: LDAP / Active Directory
ldap.desc: Corporate directory · staff sign in with their domain account

google.name: Google
google.desc: OAuth 2.0 · Google Workspace and Gmail accounts

auth.policiesDesc: Apply to every sign-in method above.
auth.signupHint: Invited users still choose any enabled method.
auth.sessionHint: Users sign in again after this much inactivity.
auth.warnNone: No sign-in method is on. Nobody will be able to sign in to the app after the next release.
auth.warnOpen: Anyone can create an account and two-step verification is off. Consider at least “Optional”.

modules.offWarning: {name} is off. {used} rely on it — they will show as problems.
modules.footnote: Turning a module off hides its blocks, layers and settings in the Studio. Its data is kept, and it returns as it was when turned back on. Changes ship with the next release.

auth.label: Users & sign-in
auth.desc: Accounts, roles and the sign-in settings.

workflows.label: Workflows
workflows.desc: Approvals and state machines for records.

comments.label: Comments & activity
comments.desc: Threads and an activity feed on records.

workflows.newDesc: Starts with New → In progress → Done. Edit the states after.
workflows.name: Name
workflows.emptyDesc: A workflow is the list of states a record moves through, like New → Approved → Done.
workflows.title: {name} workflow
workflows.deleteDesc: Records keep their current status, but moves are no longer checked.
workflows.removeStateUses: {n} move(s) use this state and will be removed too.
workflows.sameState: A move needs two different states
workflows.allConnected: Every pair of states already has a move

git.pathHint: Where the definition is written in the repo.
git.autoCommitDesc: Each release becomes a tagged commit, e.g. v1.5.
git.openPr: Open a pull request for Studio changes
git.openPrDesc: Reviewers approve in Git before changes are merged.
git.authorize: You’ll be asked to authorize Platon on {provider}.
git.neverCommitted: Records, files and secrets are never committed.
git.noCommits: No commits yet. The next release creates one.

validate.label: Check definition
validate.desc: Broken links, missing fields, rule conflicts

tests.label: Run tests
tests.desc: Checks on pages, rules and access

cicd.varsNote: Secrets are write-only and never appear in the app definition, logs or Studio AI.

agent.saved: Agent.md saved. Studio AI uses it from the next message.
agent.leave: Agent.md has unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
agent.howBody: Read before every request, for everyone on the project. Use it for naming, rules and tone the AI should always follow.
